_readme: Google Alerts RSS feeds, used as extra TIMING SIGNALS by tools/news-post.mjs.
The same rule applies to these as to every other feed in this project: the
news chooses WHICH scenario to post and never supplies WHAT the post says.
Nothing from an alert is quoted, linked or named. Only the count is used.
HOW TO ADD ONE (each takes about a minute, and needs a Google account):
2. Show options -> Deliver to: RSS feed
3. Create Alert, then click the RSS icon next to it
4. Copy that feed url into the list below with the drill it should surface
Why bother when Google News RSS already works: Alerts catches sources News
misses (blogs, .gov notices, small local outlets) and lets you tune a query
once rather than encoding it here. Empty list is fine — news-post falls back
to its built-in Google News queries and behaves exactly as before.
drill must be one of: ck, traffic, step, pass, trap, last30.
NOT door — those drills are held for attorney and DV-clinician review.
